title: WIST tree file (WIST-1)
description: One file of a Catalog's tree, served as the JCS octets of this object and named by the SHA-256 of those octets: a bucket listing Items, or a node listing its children by key-digit prefix (WIST-1 §4). It is not signed; the Catalog's `tree` commits to the root file.

prefix.description: The leading hexadecimal digits of the key shared by every Item under this child (WIST-1 §4).

count.description: The number of Items under this child.

file.description: SHA-256 of the octets of the child's tree file.
